column1: # Batch B semantic proof mutants: fill_window, longest_match, deflate_fast, deflate_slow, deflate_stored.
# Run with tests/audit/proofmut.sh. Each row's script (deflate-strategies.py) makes the mutant in the translation and the
# same edit in every proof restatement of that code, in the case splits on its condition and in the arithmetic facts that
# only restate the mutated expression, so only a semantic lemma can fail; the listed module is where that lemma is.
# First errors (tests/audit/proofmut.sh, PROOFMUT PASS: 10 killed, 1 equivalent; dev 6b7504ce, 2026-11-12):
#   fill-more-room        more = window_size - lookahead - strstart + 1;
#                         deflate.c.engine.fill-read:60, nle: the first read no longer fits the 65536-byte window.
#   fill-slide-threshold  the slide test strstart >= wsize + MAX_DIST loses MIN_LOOKAHEAD (never slides);
#                         deflate.c.engine.fill-room:57, fill_room_no_slide: no free space and no 262 bytes of lookahead.
#   lm-limit-dropped      longest_match: limit = 0 instead of strstart - MAX_DIST;
#                         deflate.c.engine.lmmain:263, lmRest_ok needs the MAX_DIST limit for the distance of GoodMatch.
#   lm-window-end         lm_cond: scan < strend becomes scan <= strend;
#                         deflate.c.engine.lminner:91: the scan passes strstart + 258 (eight more bytes compared).
#   lm-nice-clamp         longest_match: the clamp of nice_match to lookahead is dropped. Equivalent for safety: the
#                         compared bytes stay below strstart + 258 < window_size and the return value is clamped to
#                         lookahead; only the search may run longer.
#   fast-refill-test      deflate_fast: lookahead < MIN_LOOKAHEAD becomes lookahead < MIN_MATCH before fill_window;
#                         deflate.c.universal-strategies:3648, the search without refill lacks the window room.
#   fast-insert-bound     deflate_fast: the lookahead >= MIN_MATCH test of the match insertion is dropped;
#                         deflate.c.universal-strategies:3373: no 3 bytes of lookahead for the inserted strings.
#   slow-insert-bound     deflate_slow: max_insert = strstart + lookahead - MIN_MATCH + 1;
#                         deflate.c.engine.short-match-advance:90: an inserted string lacks 3 bytes of data.
#   slow-lazy-flush       deflate_slow: the FLUSH_BLOCK_ONLY after a lazy literal fills the symbol buffer is dropped;
#                         deflate.c.engine.slow-literal-loop:161, slow_literal_full_flush_loop: the full-buffer literal step
#                         states the flush. This engine lemma is imported by the universal chain and fails before
#                         deflate.c.universal-slow, whose own literal step needs the flush for the next tally, is built.
#   stored-have-room      deflate_stored: len is capped at have + 1 instead of have;
#                         deflate.c.universal-stored-loop:941, stored_rest lenHave: the block does not fit the output.
#   stored-left-clip      deflate_stored: the clip of left to len is dropped;
#                         deflate.c.universal-stored-loop:547, directLeft_le: the window copy exceeds len.
fill-more-room
fill-slide-threshold
lm-limit-dropped
lm-window-end
fast-refill-test
fast-insert-bound
slow-insert-bound
slow-lazy-flush
stored-have-room
stored-left-clip
lm-nice-clamp
